claim: Fix the smooth cubic \(S\subset\mathbb P^3_{\mathbb F_2}\) defined by \(G=X^2Y+XY^2+Z^2W+ZW^2\). Exactly \(144\) distinct divisors \(C=S\cap V(F)\) are geometrically smooth when \(F\) runs over quartic forms vanishing at all \(15\) points of \(\mathbb P^3(\mathbb F_2)\), with \(F\) identified modulo multiples \(G\cdot L\) for linear \(L\). Each is a smooth geometrically integral, degree-\(12\), genus-\(19\), ordinary curve containing all \(15\) rational points. The quartic-section space has dimension \(16\) over \(\mathbb F_2\), with \(65536\) classes; exactly \(288\) classes define curves nonsingular at every rational point, and exactly \(144\) of these are globally smooth. Every globally smooth curve has full-rank \(19\times19\) Hasse–Witt matrix. These counts arise from a complete finite-field enumeration and exact Groebner/Jacobian certificates.

integrity.method: Exhaustive binary linear-system enumeration, exact four-chart Jacobian Gröbner tests, and explicit Frobenius matrix over F2.

scientific_limitations: Census restricted to one fixed cubic and quartic sections defined over F2; no isomorphism or orbit classification.
The finite enumeration is exact but has no external independent audit.
Broader follow-up computational literature is incompletely indexed and remains a residual originality risk.

title: Exact census and ordinarity of genus-nineteen space-filling quartic sections over the binary field
